release.title: Labour Force Survey, October 2026
release.highlights: Employment was little changed in October ( -4 ,700; 0.0%) and the employment rate fell 0.1 percentage points to 60.5%. The unemployment rate rose 0.2 percentage points to 6.7%. The unemployment rate for youth aged 15 to 24 increased 0.7 percentage points to 13.7%. It also rose for people aged 55 and older (+0.2 percentage points to 5.5%).

methodology_rules.title: Age group-structure confounding in Geography comparisons
methodology_rules.rule: Do not publish raw comparisons across Geography while Age group is held at '15 years and over'; standardize to '25 to 54 years'. Raw 15+ provincial rate gaps reflect population age composition rather than purely labour-market differences.

semantic_rule.explanation: Raw 15+ provincial rate gaps reflect population age composition rather than purely labour-market differences.

methodology_rules.title: Endpoint and multi-period comparison caveats
methodology_rules.rule: Long-run and window changes compare specific start and end periods rather than asserting linear paths or causal proof.
